name: Turkey
body:
TURKEY
CR 1/3

XP 135
N Small animal
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+2 natural, +1 size)
hp 6 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +2, Will +0

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)
Melee bite +1 (1d4-1), 2 talons +1 (1d3-1)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 11, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 8
Base Atk +0; CMB -4; CMD 6
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +6, Perception +4

ECOLOGY

Environment cold and temperate forests

Organization solitary, pair, or rafter (2-24)

Treasure none

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a turkey familiar gains a +3 bonus on Intimidate checks.

ABOUT

This plump fowl has dark plumage, great and long wattles, and a spread tail, though shorter than a peacock’s display. Its gobble is loud and intimidating. Wild turkeys in their native forests are slender, ferocious, and surprisingly good at flight. Domesticated turkeys are much plumper; their flight maneuverability is clumsy and they gain the drift special ability of a chicken or peafowl. Domesticated turkeys are mainly raised for their meat.
